sources.title: Moonshot Kimi K3.1 Pro API/announce (Oct 23, weights by Nov 4)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Announcement and API live Oct 23 17:15:24Z (13:15 EDT), 4h44m36s inside exclusive 22:00Z cutoff; X post ID 2113680701770068067 archived as raw HTML; full weights promised by Nov 4 and NOT currently available.
claims.context: X raw HTML 208731B SHA 0891bc1e (embedded 2026-10-23T17:15:24.000Z) + tech blog

claims.text: 2.8T total / 104B active MoE, 1M-token multimodal context; Highspeed variant 2-3x faster at 2x price with cache-hit pricing unchanged; $2 input / $10 output per 1M.

Terminal-Bench 4.0 65.7% vs GPT-6 Astra 58.2% vs Claude Opus 5.5 66.4%; Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon 61.2% vs K3 55.95%; BenchCAD 92.7% with tools; OfficeQA Pro v2 64.4; hallucination claim rate 23.4% to 8.3% on Kimi Hallu Bench Hard.
claims.context: https://www.kimi.ai/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro (harness footnotes: Claude-Code harness, temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, max effort)

claims.text: Targeted cyber-data removal at mid-training and RL stages; checkpoint without controls solves 90.5% xdev-bench-hard vs 81.0% final; capability still behind frontier proprietary models.

limitations.text: Weights unavailable until Nov 4: no independent local run or weight-hash verification; vendor harnesses and denominators; API pricing is not weight-license terms
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
